own_solution.law: Exponential decay A_i(t) = A_i0 2^(-t/T_i); equal count rates eps A_1 = eps A_2 gives t = log2(A_10/A_20) / (1/T_1 - 1/T_2)

defect_reasons.insufficient_boundary_condition: T45EB ('Another 170 Bq batch of the longer-lived isotope is added to the sample') does not say when the batch is added or at what moment it has 170 Bq; if added later than preparation the answer differs (e.g. added at t = 6 h with 170 Bq then gives a different crossing time than 12.05 h), so the answer is not unique.

counterexamples: T45EB with the batch added at t = 10 h having 170 Bq then: long-lived activity for t > 10 h is 500*2^(-t/72) + 170*2^(-(t-10)/72) = 670*2^(-t/72)*... (equivalent initial 170*2^(10/72) = 186.9 Bq), giving t = 72/11*log2(2400/686.9) = 11.82 h instead of 12.05 h.
notes: Base: log2(4.8) = 2.26303, t = 2.26303*72/11 = 14.8126 h. With 670 Bq long-lived at preparation: log2(2400/670) = 1.84080, t = 12.0489 h. Efficiency cancels (same for both), so C. Waste-drum and earlier-sample sentences are D. T9D9A and TF3A2 carry no number while TADA4 and T84B6 state 170 Bq; check in pass 2 whether they are declared numeral-free controls. T7283 is well specified (at the moment of preparation).
